title: Jira intake
intent: Connect Jira intake to work item creation, with dedupe.

title: Slack intake
intent: Connect Slack intake to work item creation and reply with the link.

title: Start the flow
intent: Start the configured flow when a work item is created.

title: Agent stage
intent: Launch the Claude Code agent stage with the pinned context bundle.

title: Artifact hash check
intent: Verify the agent's artifact hash before advancing.

title: Resume after restart
intent: Resume in-flight work items after a restart.

title: Gate approvals
intent: Create a pending approval at each gate; approve or send back.

title: No self-approval
intent: Block a person from approving a gate on work they triggered or produced.

title: Approval SLA
intent: Flag overdue approvals and notify the approver.

title: Agent escalations
intent: Let an agent ask a person a question, pass the answer back, and cap repeated questions.

title: Event log
intent: Write every stage, gate and escalation event to an append-only log.

title: Evidence Pack
intent: Assemble and export the Evidence Pack for a work item.

title: Tamper detection
intent: Detect altered events and keep evidence in write-once storage.

title: Dashboard: approvals
intent: Dashboard sign-in, the pending approvals list and the gate screen.

title: Dashboard: timeline
intent: Show a work item's timeline of stages, decisions and escalations.

title: Merge and deploy
intent: Merge after final approval, run the deploy stage and record the result.

title: Connector testkit
intent: Run the shared connector testkit for the GitHub connector in CI.
